+            tickers=tuple(returns["tickers"]),
+            values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in returns["values"].items()},

+from risk.drawdown import max_drawdown

+
+
+def _returns(payload: dict) -> Returns:
+    return Returns(
+        base_date=payload["base_date"],
+        dates=tuple(payload["dates"]),
+        tickers=tuple(payload["tickers"]),
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in payload["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def test_sample_gives_one_drawdown_per_ticker_in_order(contract_sample) -> None:
+    drawdowns = max_drawdown(_returns(contract_sample("risk.Returns")))
+    assert [d.ticker for d in drawdowns] == ["AAA", "BBB"]
+    assert all(isinstance(d, Drawdown) for d in drawdowns)
+    assert all(d.depth <= 0.0 and d.peak_date <= d.trough_date for d in drawdowns)
+
+
+def test_sample_aaa_matches_drawdown_sample(contract_sample) -> None:
+    aaa = max_drawdown(_returns(contract_sample("risk.Returns")))[0]
+    expected = contract_sample("risk.Drawdown")["drawdowns"][0]
+    assert aaa.peak_date == expected["peak_date"]
+    assert aaa.trough_date == expected["trough_date"]
+    assert aaa.depth == pytest.approx(expected["depth"], rel=1e-8)
+
+
+def test_sample_bbb_trough_below_base_measured_from_later_peak(contract_sample) -> None:
+    bbb = max_drawdown(_returns(contract_sample("risk.Returns")))[1]
+    # Peak after the first return (2024-01-03); trough two dates later, by hand.
+    assert bbb.peak_date == "2024-01-03"
+    assert bbb.trough_date == "2024-01-05"
+    assert bbb.depth == pytest.approx(exp(-0.0059701669 - 0.008016075) - 1.0, rel=1e-9)
+
+
+def test_no_fall_gives_zero_depth_on_base_date() -> None:
+    returns = Returns(base_date="d0", dates=("d1", "d2"), tickers=("X",), values={"X": (0.1, 0.0)})
+    assert max_drawdown(returns) == (
+        Drawdown(ticker="X", depth=0.0, peak_date="d0", trough_date="d0"),
+    )

+"""Unit tests for risk.vol.rolling_vol (spine: expanding stdev of earlier returns)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+from risk.types import Returns
+from risk.vol import rolling_vol
+
+
+def _returns(payload: dict) -> Returns:
+    return Returns(
+        base_date=payload["base_date"],
+        dates=tuple(payload["dates"]),
+        tickers=tuple(payload["tickers"]),
+        values={t: tuple(v) for t, v in payload["values"].items()},
+    )
+
+
+def test_sample_gives_none_until_window_earlier_returns(contract_sample) -> None:
+    returns = _returns(contract_sample("risk.Returns"))
+    vol = rolling_vol(returns, 2)
+    assert vol.returns is returns
+    assert vol.window == 2
+    assert vol.annualized is False
+    assert set(vol.values) == {"AAA", "BBB"}
+    for series in vol.values.values():
+        assert len(series) == len(returns.dates)
+        assert series[:2] == (None, None)
+        assert all(v is not None and v > 0 for v in series[2:])
+
+
+def test_sample_values_are_expanding_sample_stdev(contract_sample) -> None:
+    vol = rolling_vol(_returns(contract_sample("risk.Returns")), 2)
+    # AAA, n - 1 denominator: two returns give |a - b| / sqrt(2); three, worked by hand.
+    assert vol.values["AAA"][2] == pytest.approx(0.0317792277 / 2.0**0.5, rel=1e-8)
+    assert vol.values["AAA"][3] == pytest.approx(0.0217571, rel=1e-5)
+
+
+def test_known_series_expands_over_all_earlier_returns() -> None:
+    returns = Returns(
+        base_date="d0",
+        dates=("d1", "d2", "d3", "d4"),
+        tickers=("X",),
+        values={"X": (1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 100.0)},
+    )
+    vol = rolling_vol(returns, 2)
+    # stdev(1, 3) = sqrt(2); stdev(1, 3, 5) = 2; the last return itself is never used.
+    assert vol.values["X"][0] is None
+    assert vol.values["X"][1] is None
+    assert vol.values["X"][2] == pytest.approx(2.0**0.5)
+    assert vol.values["X"][3] == pytest.approx(2.0)
+
+
+def test_window_larger_than_series_is_all_none() -> None:
+    returns = Returns(base_date="d0", dates=("d1", "d2"), tickers=("X",), values={"X": (0.1, 0.2)})
+    assert rolling_vol(returns, 3).values["X"] == (None, None)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("window", [1, 0, -2])
+def test_window_below_two_raises(window: int) -> None:
+    returns = Returns(base_date="d0", dates=("d1",), tickers=("X",), values={"X": (0.1,)})
